item.media:description: Daiyan Henley (0) was supposed to be heading to Denver for two draft picks, but the trade has been called off.

item.title: Kirk Cousins sees return to Vikings, following trade from Raiders, as unfinished business
item.description: Cousins has overcome plenty of obstacles to find success as an NFL quarterback. Back with the Vikings, he's hoping to save their season.
item.media:description: Kirk Cousins has overcome plenty of obstacles to find success as an NFL quarterback. He's hoping to find more as he returns to the Vikings.

item.title: Cardinals QB Carson Beck to make NFL debut vs. Rams: 'This is a dream of mine'
item.description: Beck, whom the Cardinals drafted in the third round, will be Arizona's third starting quarterback in as many weeks.
item.media:description: Carson Beck, whom the Cardinals drafted in the third round, will make his first career start Sunday.

item.title: Rams targeting Week 13 return for Davante Adams; Puka Nacua out 'extended period of time'
item.description: The Rams didn't trade for a wide receiver ahead of the deadline, but they're hoping to have Adams back for Week 13 vs. the Chiefs.
item.media:description: Davante Adams has missed the Rams' last three games with a ruptured hamstring.

item.title: Drew Brees gets in line behind favorites for potential 'Monday Night Football' booth opening
item.description: “At the end of the day, I aspire to be the best at what I’m pursuing," Brees told Front Office Sports.
item.media:description: NFL Hall of Famer and current Fox analyst Drew Brees would love to join ESPN's "Monday Night Football" broadcast.

item.title: Titans' Calvin Ridley: Airport incident was about miscommunication with valet
item.description: "He broke his finger" during the incident, Ridley said of the valet. “I don’t know what I did ... I don't know what happened."
item.media:description: Calvin Ridley has six receptions for 91 yards this season for the Titans.

item.title: Bengals apologize for Arnold Ebiketie trade deadline debacle
item.description: De facto general manager Duke Tobin had coach Zac Taylor convey his apology Wednesday for the failed deal.
item.media:description: Director of player personnel Duke Tobin and the Bengals nixed Tuesday's trade after realizing they would lose a third-round compensatory pick.
